question.en: A stone is thrown vertically upwards from the top of a tower with a velocity of 20 m/s. It reaches the ground after 6 seconds. If g = 10 m/s², what is the height of the tower?
question.si: කුළුණක මුදුනේ සිට ගලක් සිරස් අතට ඉහළට 20 m/s ප්‍රවේගයෙන් විසි කරනු ලැබේ. එය තත්පර 6 කට පසුව පොළොවට ළඟා වේ. g = 10 m/s² නම්, කුළුණේ උස කොපමණද?

explanation.en: Using displacement formula s = ut + 0.5at². Let upwards direction be positive. u = +20 m/s, a = -10 m/s², t = 6 s. Therefore, s = (20)(6) + 0.5(-10)(6²) = 120 - 180 = -60 meters. The displacement is -60 meters, which means the stone ends up 60 meters below its starting point (the top of the tower). Hence, height of the tower is 60m.
explanation.si: විස්ථාපන සූත්‍රය s = ut + 0.5at² භාවිතයෙන්. ඉහළ දිශාව ධන ලෙස සලකන්න. u = +20 m/s, a = -10 m/s², t = 6 s. s = (20)(6) + 0.5(-10)(6²) = 120 - 180 = -60 මීටර්. විස්ථාපනය -60 m වන බැවින්, ගල ආරම්භක ස්ථානයට වඩා මීටර් 60ක් පහළින් පිහිටයි. එබැවින් කුළුණේ උස 60m වේ.

question.en: Which of the following statements is correct regarding a particle executing circular motion at a constant speed?
question.si: ඒකාකාර වේගයෙන් වෘත්ත චලිතයක යෙදෙන අංශුවක් සම්බන්ධයෙන් පහත ප්‍රකාශවලින් නිවැරදි වන්නේ කුමක්ද?

en: The net force on it acts towards the center of the path.
No work is done by the centripetal force, and kinetic energy is variable.
si: එයට ඇතිවන ශුද්ධ බලය වෘත්තාකාර මාර්ගයේ කේන්ද්‍රය දෙසට ක්‍රියා කරයි.
කේන්ද්‍රභිසාරී බලයෙන් කාර්යයක් සිදු නොවන අතර චාලක ශක්තිය විචල්‍ය වේ.

explanation.en: In uniform circular motion, speed is constant but direction changes continuously, so velocity changes and there is a centripetal acceleration. Centripetal acceleration (and thus the net force) is always directed towards the center. The centripetal force is always perpendicular to velocity, so work done is zero and kinetic energy remains constant.
explanation.si: ඒකාකාර වෘත්ත චලිතයේදී වේගය නියත වුවද දිශාව නිරන්තරයෙන් වෙනස් වේ, එබැවින් ප්‍රවේගය වෙනස් වන අතර කේන්ද්‍රභිසාරී ත්වරණයක් පවතී. මෙම බලය සැමවිටම කේන්ද්‍රය දෙසට ක්‍රියා කරයි. ප්‍රවේගයට ලම්බකව ක්‍රියා කරන බැවින් කාර්යය ශුන්‍ය වන අතර චාලක ශක්තිය නියතව පවතී.

question.en: Two blocks of masses 2 kg and 3 kg are in contact on a frictionless horizontal surface. A horizontal force of 10 N is applied to the 2 kg block. What is the contact force between the blocks?
question.si: ඝර්ෂණයක් නොමැති තිරස් තලයක් මත එකිනෙක ස්පර්ශ වෙමින් පවතින කිලෝග්‍රෑම් 2 සහ 3 ක ස්කන්ධ දෙකක් ඇත. 2 kg ස්කන්ධය මත 10 N ක තිරස් බලයක් යෙදූ විට, ස්කන්ධ දෙක අතර ස්පර්ශක බලය කොපමණද?

explanation.en: First find common acceleration: F_total = m_total * a => 10 N = (2kg + 3kg) * a => a = 2 m/s². Now consider the 3 kg block. The only force accelerating it is the contact force (C) from the 2 kg block. C = mass * a = 3 kg * 2 m/s² = 6 N.
explanation.si: පළමුව පොදු ත්වරණය සොයන්න: F = m * a => 10 N = (2 + 3) * a => a = 2 m/s². දැන් 3 kg ස්කන්ධය සලකන්න. එය ත්වරණය කරවන්නේ 2 kg මඟින් ඇති කරන ස්පර්ශක බලය (C) පමණි. C = m * a = 3 kg * 2 m/s² = 6 N වේ.

forums.title: Confusion regarding Limiting Friction vs Sliding Friction
forums.content: When solving problems of force equilibrium on inclined planes, why does the object sometimes remain stationary even when the calculated pulling force is greater than kinetic friction? Is limiting static friction always the maximum threshold we should check first?

replies.content: Yes Kasun! Limiting static friction (F_max = μ_s * R) is the absolute peak resistance of the surface. Until the external disturbing force exceeds this limiting value, the object will NOT budge, and static friction will match your external force exactly. Once it slips, the friction drops to kinetic friction (μ_k * R). Always check against μ_s first!

mcqQuestions.question: A uniform cylindrical rod of length L and cross-sectional area A floats vertically in water with 2/3 of its length submerged. When pushed down slightly and released, it performs simple harmonic motion. If the density of water is ρ and acceleration due to gravity is g, what is the period of oscillation T?

A block of mass m is placed on a rough horizontal surface with coefficient of static friction μ. A force F is applied at an angle θ above the horizontal. What is the minimum magnitude of force F required to just move the block along the horizontal surface?
options: F = μmg / (cos θ - μ sin θ)
F = μmg / (sin θ + μ cos θ)

mcqQuestions.question: A particle is projected from the base of an inclined plane of inclination 30° with a speed u at an angle of 60° to the horizontal. What is the range of the particle along the inclined plane?

A solid sphere and a hollow cylinder of equal mass M and radius R roll without slipping down an inclined plane of angle θ from rest. What is the ratio of their translational accelerations (a_sphere / a_cylinder)?

A non-viscous, incompressible fluid flows steadily through a horizontal pipe whose diameter narrows from D to D/2. If the speed of the fluid at the wider section is v, what is the pressure difference (P1 - P2) between the two sections (density = ρ)?

A sound source moves toward a stationary observer with speed v_s = 0.2 v (where v is the speed of sound in air). Simultaneously, the observer moves away from the source at 0.1 v. If the emitted frequency is f₀, what is the apparent frequency heard by the observer?

Two coherent monochromatic sound sources S1 and S2 emit in phase at wavelength λ. An observer moves along a perpendicular line from S1 to S2. What condition specifies the first position of destructive interference?

An ideal gas undergoes a cycle consisting of an isobaric expansion at pressure P₀ from V₀ to 2V₀, an isochoric cooling to pressure P₀/2, and an adiabatic return to the initial state. What is the net work done during the isobaric step?

A heat engine works between an absolute temperature reservoir of T_H = 600 K and a cold sink T_C = 300 K. If it absorbs 1200 J from the hot source and produces 400 J of work, what is the ratio of its actual efficiency to the maximum theoretical Carnot efficiency?
Two point charges +4q and -q are fixed at a distance d apart. At what point on the line passing through both charges is the net electric field intensity zero?
options: At distance d/2 between the two charges
At distance d from -q on the side opposite to +4q
At distance 2d from +4q between the charges
At distance 2d from -q between the charges

mcqQuestions.question: A parallel plate capacitor with plate area A and separation d is filled with two dielectric slabs of thickness d/2 with dielectric constants k1 and k2 in series. What is the equivalent capacitance?
Twelve identical resistors, each of resistance R, are connected along the edges of a cube. What is the equivalent resistance between two diagonally opposite corners of the cube?

In a potentiometer circuit, a wire of length 100 cm has a resistance of 10 Ω. It is connected in series with a 40 Ω resistor and an accumulator of EMF 2.0 V (zero internal resistance). What is the potential gradient along the potentiometer wire?
A circular coil of radius r with N turns carries a current I. At what axial distance x from the center of the coil is the magnetic flux density equal to 1/8 of that at the center?
A conducting circular loop of radius R and electrical resistance r is placed perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field B = B₀ cos(ωt). What is the peak thermal power dissipated in the loop?
An alternating voltage V = 200√2 sin(100πt) V is applied across an inductor of inductance L = 0.5/π H. What is the root-mean-square current through the inductor?

A beam of light traveling in a medium with refractive index n1 strikes an interface with a medium of refractive index n2 at Brewster's angle θ_B. If n1 = √3 and n2 = 1, what is the angle of refraction?
In Young's double slit experiment, if the entire apparatus is immersed in water of refractive index 4/3 without altering slit separation or screen distance, what happens to the fringe width β?
options: Increases to (4/3) of its original value
Decreases to (3/4) of its original value
Decreases to (9/16) of its original value

mcqQuestions.question: A convex lens of focal length 20 cm in air is made of glass (n = 1.5). When immersed in a liquid of refractive index 1.25, what will be its new focal length?

A metal surface is irradiated with light of frequency ν, and the stopping potential is V₁. When irradiated with light of frequency 2ν, the stopping potential becomes V₂. If e is the elementary charge, what is Planck's constant h?
According to the Bohr model of the hydrogen atom, what is the ratio of the radius of the third orbit (n = 3) to that of the ground state (n = 1)?
A radioactive isotope has a half-life of 20 days. Starting with an initial activity of 800 Bq, what will be its activity after 60 days?
In an n-p-n bipolar junction transistor connected in common-emitter configuration, the base current is 25 μA and the collector current is 2.475 mA. What is the common-emitter current gain β?

An operational amplifier (op-amp) configured as an inverting amplifier has input resistance R_in = 10 kΩ and feedback resistance R_f = 220 kΩ. If an input voltage of -0.05 V is applied, what is the output voltage (assuming supply voltage ±15 V)?
Which combination of logic gates can implement a standard two-input exclusive-OR (XOR) function using the minimum number of 2-input NAND gates?
A steel wire of length 2.0 m and cross-sectional area 1.0 mm² is stretched by a force of 200 N. If Young's modulus for steel is 2.0 × 10¹¹ N/m², what is the elastic energy stored in the wire?
A uniform meter rule of mass 100 g is balanced horizontally on a knife-edge placed at the 40 cm mark when a mass m is suspended from the 10 cm mark. What is the value of mass m?
A satellite of mass m orbits the Earth at a circular radius r with orbital speed v. What is the total mechanical energy of the satellite?

A capillary tube of radius r is dipped vertically into water of surface tension T and contact angle zero. If the atmospheric pressure is P₀, what is the pressure inside the water just below the curved meniscus?
In a thermo-electric couple, the cold junction is maintained at 0 °C and the neutral temperature is 280 °C. What is the temperature of inversion for this thermocouple?
